rv.q: It might not be enough for this show.
But the play's episodic nature is too much tell, not enough show.
With intentional casting and whimsical performances, this production will be a treat for audiences.
But the production’s push-and-pull ultimately frustrates.

cn.t: Taylor Mac dazzles in this revival of Sarah Ruhl's adaptation, but the production struggles to fully capitalize on its timely gender-fluid themes, resulting in a spirited yet uneven theatrical experience.
